space: island-local metres, Z up, island centre at the origin, rim ground about z = 0 (Port candidate)
note: Everything Blender builds around the maze. Heights that depend on the terrain (gate, tower base) are sampled from the ground at build time.

gate.note: the Port rim is only about 0.6 m wide at the south, so the gate stands on a stone bridgehead that extends the island

bridge.plank: kenney_pirate-kit/platform-planks.glb (two side by side per segment)
bridge.note: each segment is its own collection (BRIDGE_SEG_01..06) so a cartoon blow-up and a rebuild by the robot crew can address segments one by one

sockets.attaches: racetrack / road route from the next island (RKIT route start socket)

slots.note: guard post at the island end of the bridge

tower.rule: middle count = max(0, ceil((lampTargetZ - (groundZ + 2.0 + 1.39)) / 2.0)); the lamp clears rim (0) + wall (1.6) + 2.0 on any terrain
